newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt paper prices slip on costly roubles.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt paper prices slip on costly roubles.

text.p: Prices of Russian government paper slipped about 0.1 percent on Thursday as investors, faced with unexpectedly expensive roubles, decided not to borrow finance purchases of the paper, dealers said.
*Average yield rose to 18.5 pct from 18.0 pct on Tuesday
*Turnover rose to 4.46 trln rbls from 3.83 trln rbls
*Banks transferred 2.30 trln rbls for the trading
*Central bank sold 2.5 bln rbls of T-bills
Bank Kredit-Moskva dealer Nikolai Yeliseyev said prices nudged down after overnight credits surged on Wednesday, with long-term paper leading the fall.

Overnight interbank credits fell to 6-11 percent on Thursday from 10-20 percent on Wednesday. The delayed effect due to the fact that there is no secondary trading on Wednesdays, when auctions take place.
"The market was tense today and there was a small price fall," said Mezhkombank dealer Olga Bychkova. "When a price fall starts, long-term OFZs suffer the most."
